import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
const SYSTEMD_DIR = '/run/systemd/system';
const hasDir = existsSync(SYSTEMD_DIR);
const booted = hasDir && process.env.NEVER === '1';
test('acceptance: two hops', { skip: !booted && 'needs a disposable Linux CI runner with systemd' }, () => {});
